title: Xiaomi’s 1,548 hp electric supercar is going global, starting in the UAE
summary: As a red wave of Chinese-built electric vehicles breaks over Europe and Canada, Xiaomi is selling its electric cars outside of China for the first time ever – and its starting its push for global growth with the UAE in 2027. more…

title: Rumor: Hyundai is getting ready to roll out an all-new, all-electric work truck
summary: The last time Hyundai announced a new work truck was 22 years ago, and the Hyundai Porter has proven itself as a dependable workhorse throughout Korea and Southeast Asia – but only the pyramids and the Chevy Express can last forever. Hyundai is reportedly getting ready to pull the wraps off an all-new Porter pickup. This time, it’s electric . more…

title: Briggs & Stratton keeps the lights on longer with bigger 16 kWh LFP battery
summary: For decades, Briggs & Stratton has helped keep the lights on after the storm with its gas-powered generators. Now, the company is bringing that legacy to the electric age with a new 16 kWh backup battery designed to scale with your growing energy needs. more…

title: E-quipment highlight: Tadano rolls out 35-ton V320RC electric crane
summary: Developed by Japanese material handling giant Tadano, the 35-ton V320RC wheeled electric pick & carry crane has spent the last few months proving itself at NMG Italia’s job sites, where it’s been handling heavy loads in tight industrial spaces and improving efficiency by 50%. And now, you can buy one. more…

title: From equipment to ferries to locomotives, Illinois ports are getting a ZEV makeover
summary: The Illinois Clean Ports Program is putting $104 million behind efforts to help clean up its working waterfronts, funds earmarked for heavy-duty electric equipment assets that includes forklifts, giant reach stackers, switcher locomotives, and the charging equipment needed to support them. There’s even a passenger ferry! more…

title: 11-term House rep who mocked a kid’s letter about EVs has lost her seat (Upd.)
summary: An 83 year old Congressional representative who sent an embarrassing letter to a well-meaning 10 year old constituent on the topic of electric cars and climate change, where she seems to brag about saddling his generation with debt through a recent climate rollback she voted for, has lost her seat. Update: This article was originally posted on May 14, but we wanted to update it with news of the election result. After a recount, Chuck Hubbard has defeated Virginia Foxx by 330 votes, and will go on to represent NC-5 in Congress. more…
